where: Billing: Mark Paid now opens a how-paid box and records a Payment line on the student's account; Mark Unpaid writes a Payment Reversed line; Edit Student > Account > Add Funds lists the unpaid flights (pre-ticked oldest first up to the amount typed) and pays them from the money added; the ledger on Edit Student / Account page shows Payment / Payment Reversed badges
detail: One shared helper, flight_payments.py (record_flight_payment / reverse_flight_payment / apply_funds_to_flights, documented in the module), is used by Billing's Mark Paid/Unpaid, Mark N selected paid, Pay with Card, Add Funds and Wave's 'invoice paid' sync, so balance and unpaid total always agree. Idempotent: an already-paid flight records nothing again; the amount is always what the flight still needs. Mark Unpaid reverses only payment lines tied to that flight (credit applied at End Session is left alone - documented). tests/test_flight_payments.py checks each path against the Billing Cross-Check logic. The 'fly' builder wires FLY-10/FLY-11 to flight_payments.record_flight_payment / reverse_flight_payment after merge; the existing /flight/log/{id}/toggle_paid route already goes through it.
